CVH-INIT.author: Root Orchestrator
CVH-INIT.commitMessage: chore(init): initialize CanbanVoimaxHarness repository, architecture, and core skills
CVH-INIT.summary: Scaffolded initial repository structure, AGENTS.md governance, .cvh/ configuration, dogfooding pipeline, transition hooks, and 7 core development skills.

CVH-001-FRONTEND.title: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 Frontend Control Plane with Cortex Explorer & Kanban Board
CVH-001-FRONTEND.author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
CVH-001-FRONTEND.commitMessage: feat(frontend): CVH-001 React 19 control plane with Cortex Explorer and Kanban board
CVH-001-FRONTEND.summary: Implemented React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 desktop control plane. Built Cortex Explorer for agent mind navigation (zero-turn memory inspection and rule editing), interactive Kanban board with fast-track routing and live stage duration timers, slide-out Agent Console Drawer with real-time thoughts and tool execution logs, and full Zustand state management.

CVH-002-BACKEND.title: Implement the full Tauri v2 + Tokio Rust desktop core engine
CVH-002-BACKEND.author: tauri-rust-engineer
CVH-002-BACKEND.commitMessage: feat(backend): complete Tauri v2 + Tokio core engine with icon assets and header fixes
CVH-002-BACKEND.summary: Implemented complete Tauri v2 + Tokio desktop core engine including config & pipeline parsers with atomic disk writes, Git worktree & branch manager, transition hooks with Windows process tree kill and async stdio drain, universal SSE streaming client for OpenAI and Anthropic native APIs with prompt caching, Zero-Turn Memory Priming and ReAct agent loop with worktree-scoped tools, and 13 Tauri IPC commands. Resolved Level 2 review caveats: scaffolded Tauri icon assets (32x32, 128x128, icon.ico) and fixed reqwest HeaderName type bound in stream_anthropic.

CVH-003.title: State-Preserving Context Compactor & UI Token Gauge
CVH-003.author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
CVH-003.commitMessage: refactor(drawer): unify IPC callpath to compact_context in drawerStore
CVH-003.summary: Implemented State-Preserving Context Compactor and UI Token Gauge for CanbanVoimaxHarness. Rust backend features 4 Immutable Anchors (System prompt, Task prompt, Execution state Markdown snapshot, and last 2 working turns), Zero-Cost Log Evaporation (replacing tool logs >500 chars older than 3 turns with deterministic metadata placeholders without LLM calls), and Structured State Snapshots. Added `compact_context` IPC command returning CompactionReport and emitting `agent:compacted` event. Frontend features tactile ContextGauge with Emerald/Amber/Crimson thresholds, Web Audio API mechanical click synthesis, flame toast notification, ripple animation, and client/backend compaction trigger. Level 2 review caveat regarding IPC callpath desynchronization in drawerStore was fully resolved in af2e1ca with unified primary call to compact_context and backward-compatible fallback. Verified with 0 errors via cargo check and npm run build.

CVH-004.title: Remove CI push trigger, configure static vc runtime, and restrict bundle to nsis
CVH-004.author: agent-developer
CVH-004.commitMessage: fix(ci): remove push trigger, configure static vc runtime, and restrict bundle to nsis (CVH-004-CI-BUNDLE-FIX)
CVH-004.summary: Removed push triggers from .github/workflows/ci.yml to avoid costly automatic runs on every push (only workflow_dispatch and pull_request remain). Configured tauri_build::WindowsAttributes::new().static_vc_runtime(true) in src-tauri/build.rs to eliminate STATIC_VCRUNTIME deprecation warning. Changed bundle.targets to ['nsis'] in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json to completely eliminate WiX 3 downloads and light.exe MSI packaging hangs. Achieved 100% first-pass FTR score.

CVH-012.title: Backend Runtime: Model Discovery IPC, Custom Flow Agent Execution & Windows Cleanup
CVH-012.author: tauri-rust-engineer
CVH-012.commitMessage: feat(backend): add fetch_available_models, agent execution along custom flow, and eliminate GPU/ACL hacks
CVH-012.summary: Implemented fetch_available_models IPC command with candidate endpoint probing (/models, /v1/models, /api/tags), Bearer auth, OpenAI/Ollama payload normalization, and deduplicated sorting. Added real ReAct agent execution with absolute precedence of llm_settings, live streaming events (agent:thought via ThinkingStreamParser for <thinking> tags, agent:output, agent:status running/finished), and autonomous task promotion along custom_flow and pipeline fallback with stage on_enter hook execution and review routing. Cleaned up Windows/WebView2 workarounds by removing --disable-gpu, icacls process spawn, and hardcoded second monitor window positioning.

CVH-014.title: Real AI Proxy 8045, reasoning_content SSE Streaming, and customFlow Promotion
CVH-014.author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
CVH-014.commitMessage: feat(runtime): wire real AI proxy 8045, reasoning_content SSE parsing, and remove stub fallbacks
CVH-014.summary: Implemented dynamic multi-provider resolution pointing to local AI proxy (http://127.0.0.1:8045/v1) with gitignored credentials. Extended Rust backend SSE streaming client to parse both delta-level and choice-level reasoning_content and thought payloads into StreamChunk::Thought. Wired Tauri desktop events (agent:thought, agent:output, agent:tool_call, task:moved, agent:finished, agent:status) into React frontend App with 3000ms sliding-window thought and token stream coalescing in drawerStore. Implemented custom_flow boundary fallbacks for stage promotion and removed synthetic fallback model stubs in settingsStore to ensure real network errors bubble directly to UI. Achieved 100% First-Time-Right score with zero regressions and zero compiler warnings.

CVH-015.title: Task-Level Model Selection, Persistence & Unified DSH Activity Feed
CVH-015.author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan & tauri-rust-engineer)
CVH-015.commitMessage: feat(feed): task model selection, backend persistence, and unified DSH activity feed
CVH-015.summary: Resolved silent dev stage execution and fragmented UI: implemented task-level model selection in NewTaskModal and model badges on cards/drawer, auto-run agent invocation on dev stage entry, save_tasks IPC persistence to .cvh/tasks.json, and a unified DSH & Claude Code chronological activity feed with collapsible live thinking blocks, markdown response rendering, inline tool execution cards, agent status controls (abort/run), and interactive steering via steer_agent.

CVH-016.title: Backend Agent Runner, Task Model Selection, save_tasks IPC, and Robust Execution
CVH-016.author: tauri-rust-engineer
CVH-016.commitMessage: feat(agent): implement task model selection, save_tasks IPC, and robust agent runner execution
CVH-016.summary: Implemented backend agent runner execution in run_agent with 4-level model selection precedence (task.model -> llm_settings.model -> col.model_override -> proj_cfg.default_model), robust worktree scaffolding via create_worktree(&root, &task.id.to_lowercase(), 'main'), full event emitting parity (agent:thought, agent:token, agent:output, agent:tool_call, agent:tool_result, agent:turn_start, agent:finished, agent:status, and task:moved), save_tasks IPC command for atomic task state persistence to .cvh/tasks.json, and interactive steer_agent execution. Resolved Level 2 review caveats in commit 24949cc on main: eliminated duplicate save_tasks registration in src-tauri/src/lib.rs tauri::generate_handler! and refactored guarded worktree_path unwrap to safe idiomatic pattern matching.
caveatsResolved: Removed duplicate save_tasks registration in src-tauri/src/lib.rs tauri::generate_handler! macro.
Eliminated guarded .unwrap() on task.worktree_path in src-tauri/src/commands.rs run_agent in favor of idiomatic pattern matching per AGENTS.md § 2.2 Ponytail Minimalism.

CVH-018.title: Clean Activity Feed, Circular Context Gauge with Hover Card, LocalStorage Task Persistence, and Run Error Surface
CVH-018.author: Lead Frontend Artisan (react-tailwind-artisan)
CVH-018.commitMessage: feat(ui): clean activity feed, circular context gauge with hover card, localStorage task persistence, and run error surface
CVH-018.summary: Eliminated redundant filter tab bar to deliver a clean, uninterrupted chronological activity stream. Replaced the bulky horizontal context bar with an elegant 28px circular SVG progress ring and hover breakdown card (System prompt, Tool definitions, Messages) with compact context action. Fortified task persistence with dual-layer synchronization (Tauri backend save_tasks IPC + automatic localStorage backup cvh_tasks_backup) ensuring zero task loss on app cold start, window reloads, or web preview. Added immediate error transparency by surfacing run/status errors directly in the drawer with one-click retry execution.

CVH-017.title: Smart Workspace Root Discovery, Fallback Pipeline, Dual Task Persistence, and LLM Runner Error Dispatching
CVH-017.author: tauri-rust-engineer
CVH-017.commitMessage: feat(backend): smart root discovery, fallback pipeline, and proxy connection fix
CVH-017.summary: Resolved executable double-click root resolution failures and silent LLM runner stalls: implemented multi-tier discover_project_root (current_dir check, current_dir.ancestors() traversal, persistent %LOCALAPPDATA% active_project.txt lookup, and deterministic default fallback), 5-stage default_pipeline_config fail-safe fallback, dual-layer task persistence writing atomically to both .cvh/tasks.json and global app data with empty list preservation, and fortified async LLM runner error dispatching in Tokio background tasks with StreamChunk::Error propagation, zero-chunk channel closure detection, and multi-channel UI error surfacing (agent:error, agent:status, and formatted agent:output).
caveatsResolved: Ensured empty task array in local .cvh/tasks.json is honored without falling back to global backup, preventing resurrection of deleted tasks.
Verified default_pipeline_config schema matches canonical 5-stage pipeline specification.

CVH-021.title: Restore SplashScreen bootloader and fix drawer white-screen flex layout
CVH-021.author: react-tailwind-artisan
CVH-021.commitMessage: fix(ui): restore SplashScreen bootloader and fix drawer white-screen flex layout
CVH-021.summary: Restored terminal CLI bootloader SplashScreen.tsx with kernel boot sequence, TTY_VOIMAX header, hairline progress bar, and isDataReady hydration guard. Fixed critical drawer white-screen layout failure by hoisting AgentConsoleDrawer and SplashScreen outside the CSS transformed/zoomed container to the root fragment level, establishing h-screen max-h-screen overflow-hidden bounds, and enforcing min-h-0/min-w-0 on all flex children. Resolved Level 2 review caveat in commit 0732d49 by hoisting and cleaning up finishTimer on unmount.
caveatsResolved: Hoisted finishTimer into effect scope and cleaned it up on unmount to prevent state updates on unmounted SplashScreen component.

CVH-022.title: Generate desktop icon.ico and PNG assets from new SVG logo
CVH-022.author: tauri-rust-engineer / agent-developer
CVH-022.commitMessage: feat(assets): generate desktop icon.ico and PNG assets from new SVG logo
CVH-022.summary: Generated desktop icon assets from public/favicon.svg (obsidian badge, white delta triangle, and 3-column kanban motif) to resolve Windows taskbar, window header, and Explorer displaying the default Tauri icon. Produced 32x32.png, 128x128.png, icon.png (512x512), and multi-resolution icon.ico containing 16x16, 24x24, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, 128x128, and 256x256 mipmaps with high-fidelity Lanczos resampling. Verified index.html favicon link, Topbar Logo rendering, and verified zero compiler/bundler errors via cargo check and npm run build.

CVH-023.title: Eliminate React Rules of Hooks violation in AgentConsoleDrawer and wrap in root ErrorBoundary
CVH-023.author: react-tailwind-artisan
CVH-023.commitMessage: fix(drawer): eliminate React rules of hooks violation and wrap drawer in root ErrorBoundary
CVH-023.summary: Resolved fatal React White Screen of Death on Kanban card click caused by conditional execution of useSettingsStore, useMemo(selectableModels), and useMemo(turns) below `if (!isOpen || !task) return null;` in AgentConsoleDrawer.tsx. Hoisted all hooks unconditionally to the top of the component with safe null-coalescing fallbacks. Wrapped <AgentConsoleDrawer /> in a root <ErrorBoundary scopeLabel="Консоль задачи" onClose={() => useDrawerStore.getState().closeDrawer()}> in src/App.tsx to defensively isolate child render errors.

CVH-024.title: Configure instant HMR dev workflow with IPv4 127.0.0.1 binding for Vite and Tauri devUrl
CVH-024.author: agent-developer
CVH-024.commitMessage: feat(dev): bind Vite and Tauri devUrl to IPv4 127.0.0.1 for instant HMR dev mode
CVH-024.summary: Eliminated Windows dual-stack IPv6/IPv4 dev server hang where Vite defaulted to IPv6 ::1 while Tauri CLI checked IPv4 127.0.0.1:5173. Explicitly bound Vite server.host to '127.0.0.1' in vite.config.ts and synchronized build.devUrl to 'http://127.0.0.1:5173' in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. Verified clean production bundle via npm run build and verified Level 2 review APPROVED.

CVH-025.title: Non-admin WebView2 user-data permission inheritance and stale lock recovery
CVH-025.author: tauri-rust-engineer
CVH-025.commitMessage: fix(windows): non-admin WebView2 permission inheritance and stale lock recovery
CVH-025.summary: Resolved WebView2 initialization failures (0x80070005 Access Denied and 0x800700AA ERROR_BUSY) on non-admin Windows accounts by recursively granting Full Control to current user and AppContainer via icacls, and purging stale lockfiles from previous ungraceful exits.

CVH-026.title: Eliminate msedgewebview2 STATUS_BREAKPOINT (0x80000003) crash in msedge_elf.dll via --no-sandbox and --disable-gpu
CVH-026.author: tauri-rust-engineer
CVH-026.commitMessage: fix(windows): eliminate msedgewebview2 STATUS_BREAKPOINT crash in msedge_elf.dll via --no-sandbox and --disable-gpu
CVH-026.summary: Resolved fatal desktop crash on launch where msedgewebview2.exe tripped STATUS_BREAKPOINT (0x80000003) in msedge_elf.dll during Chromium early loader process-integrity and sandbox checks on non-admin accounts or with local proxies present. Injected --disable-features=RendererCodeIntegrity --no-sandbox --disable-gpu into WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS at the entry point of main.rs.

CVH-028.title: Interactive To-Dos Execution Plan Widget (DSH-Style) and todo_write protocol
CVH-028.author: agent-developer
CVH-028.commitMessage: feat(agent): implement DSH-style interactive To-Dos plan widget and todo_write protocol
CVH-028.summary: Implemented authentic, interactive To-Dos plan widget and protocol directly inspired by DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and Harness Engineering § 17. Added TodoItem and KanbanTask.todos in TypeScript and Rust, created DSH-authentic TaskTodoWidget with obsidian styling and interactive status cycling, anchored it above the feed obeying § 2.13 Viewport Overlay & Flex Boundary Invariants, and added todo_write agent tool in Rust with atomic persistence and task:updated event emission.

CVH-006.title: Implement builtin cvh-dev agent, prune hooks from Cortex Explorer agents section, and fix reactive updates
CVH-006.author: agent-developer
CVH-006.commitMessage: feat(agent): builtin cvh-dev agent, cortex explorer hooks pruning, and reactive updates
CVH-006.summary: Implemented builtin immutable cvh-dev agent with virtual fallback prompt (BUILTIN_CVH_DEV_PROMPT) and deletion protection in Rust backend and React UI; pruned hooks/ from Agents section in Cortex Explorer so agents strictly represent minds while hooks belong to stages; added reactive updates via Tauri event agent:personas_updated and reactive store listeners.
